free_tier.stated: No standing free tier. The GLM Coding Plan has paid Lite/Pro/Max tiers with 2,000/12,000/28,000 credits per 5 hours and 10,000/60,000/140,000 per week. An occasional 2,000-credit experience card (体验卡) ends when its credits are used.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a subscription meters usage, not objects

retention.stated: not applicable: the vendor serves the inference; no caller-stored bytes

egress.terms: not applicable: the vendor serves the inference

tooling: ZCode, AutoClaw, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and WorkBuddy are named
chaining: the 5-hour and weekly credit caps are the scarce link; the plan key is separate from the standard API key and only works in approved tools

limits.value: 2,000 to 28,000 credits per 5 hours by tier
10,000 to 140,000 credits per week by tier
OpenClaw is served at lower priority with dynamic queuing under load

identity_cost.detail: a BigModel/Zhipu account and a paid subscription; exact signup fields not enumerated on these pages

reliability_note: plan credits cannot be used through the standard API, and account sharing can restrict the subscription

evidence.proved: all tiers support GLM-5.3 and GLM-5.3-Flash and the plan is subscription-only

evidence.quote: 每张体验卡包含 2,000 积分
evidence.proved: an experience card is a limited 2,000-credit grant that ends when consumed

notes: Paid-only. The '体验卡' experience card is a limited promotional grant, not a standing free tier; no price is invented.
